relations.note: The King's decision stands beneath Goldbeck's date and signature on the last page of the promemoria and refuses the reductions it proposes.

text:
Nach genauer Betrachtung der verbrach[en?]
finde keinen der Condemnirte[n?] einer
minderung der strafen
würdig vilmehr müßten die so zu guld
strafen condemnirt, seindt zu erlegung
derselben angehalten oder da[?]
sie selbiges zu prestiren nicht vermögen
zu dem Verhältniß mäßigen arest
gebracht werden.
Fr. Wilhelm
d 16 Februariy
1797

translation.en:
After close consideration of the crimes[?], I find none of the condemned[?] worthy of a reduction of the punishments; rather, those who have been condemned to money fines must be held to the payment of them, or, where[?] they are not able to pay it, be brought to an arrest in proportion to it.

Fr. Wilhelm

16 February 1797

text_english:
After close consideration of the crimes[?], I find none of the condemned[?] worthy of a reduction of the punishments; rather, those who have been condemned to money fines must be held to the payment of them, or, where[?] they are not able to pay it, be brought to an arrest in proportion to it.

Fr. Wilhelm

16 February 1797
summary_en: King Friedrich Wilhelm II's decision on Goldbeck's promemoria, written in his own hand beneath it, dated 16 February 1797 and signed Fr. Wilhelm. He finds none of the condemned worthy of a reduction of their punishment; those condemned to money fines are rather to be held to pay them and, those who cannot pay, to be put under arrest in proportion. Several words of the King's hand are doubtful readings.
summary_de: Die Entscheidung König Friedrich Wilhelms II. auf Goldbecks Promemoria, eigenhändig darunter geschrieben, datiert vom 16. Februar 1797 und unterzeichnet Fr. Wilhelm. Er findet keinen der Verurteilten einer Minderung der Strafe würdig; die zu Geldstrafen Verurteilten seien vielmehr zu deren Zahlung anzuhalten und, wer nicht zahlen kann, in verhältnismäßigen Arrest zu bringen. Mehrere Wörter der Hand des Königs sind unsichere Lesungen.
